title: fix(plugin-chatbot): name the dataset and permission build groups
body:

_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8TJHsLPCDr4wM4gWFK4ALdG)_

Fixes #27419

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:AI 搭建进度面板给「数据集」「权限」两组起了名字,十种语言都加了;以后再出现没起名的类型,一律显示「其他」,不再露出英文类型名。
- 为什么改:中文界面搭建时出现「dataset 项目」「permission …」,两个英文词夹在中文里,「permission」看着像报错,正落在首次搭建最显眼的那 15–30 秒。
- 风险与回滚:只是显示文字,不碰数据与搭建流程;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` 的 `useBuildGroupLabel`(新增两个分支,default 改为「其他」),`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh.ts` 的 `chatbot.build.group`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/buildGroupLabel-27419.test.tsx`,预期 4 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `useBuildGroupLabel` (plugin-chatbot `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`) gains two static cases, `dataset` and `permission`, and its `default` arm now answers `chatbot.build.group.other` ("Other") instead of the raw type id. The lookup stays a static switch, so `check-i18n-call-site-keys` still sees every key.
- `@object-ui/i18n`: the `chatbot.build.group` block in all ten locales (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt, ru, zh) gains `dataset`, `permission` and `other`. zh reads 数据集 / 权限 / 其他, en `Datasets` / `Permissions` / `Other`; the other eight reuse each pack's existing word for dataset, permission and other, in the plural form the five existing headings use.
- One patch changeset for `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` and `@object-ui/i18n`.

## Why

The seat ruling on the card picked "name them": the build really stages datasets and permission sets, so hiding them would make the progress list disagree with what lands in the app.

## Tests

- New pin `buildGroupLabel-27419.test.tsx`: renders one build frame carrying an artifact of each of the seven staged types (object, view, dashboard, app, seed, dataset, permission) plus one unnamed type (`flow`), in zh and en, and asserts every heading is the pack's word, that no heading equals its raw type id, and that the unnamed type falls to "Other". The staged set is not a type union in this repository (`ChatBuildProgress.items` types `type` as a free string, and cloud's `apply_blueprint` produces it), so the seven are the types a real build was observed to stage.
- `buildPanelI18n-7388.test.tsx`: its case "an unknown artifact type still renders its raw type" pinned exactly the behaviour this card retires. It now asserts 其他 and that `flow` does not render, keeping its no-raw-key half. The ui seat approved this file as a surface addition.
- Ablation, run on the committed fix with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 → 0, restore verified blob equals HEAD): restoring `default: return type` reds 3 cases (both locales of the pin's unnamed-type case and the 7388 case); restored, all 18 pass.

## Acceptance notes

- Headings stay grouped by type. Two unnamed types in one build would show two "Other" rows; merging them would change the grouping the panel links artifacts by and is outside the ruling, so it is left as is.
- de uses „Datensätze“ to match the pack's existing `dataset` word (Datensatz).
